formal_title: Empirical Noncommutative Transport, Repair↔Loss Order-Reversal Intervention, Transformation-Monoid Identification, Property-Indexed Carrier Replication, Restricted Observation-Functor Construction, Surface-Selection↔Path-Transport Two-Level Composition, Law-Family Decomposition Uniqueness & Macro-Structure Reconstruction

base.software_graph: Directed multigraph G with free path category Path(G)

structural_claims_frozen_before_fresh_ou: {D,R} is a left-zero semigroup under composition
M_CR={I,D,R} is a three-element noncommutative monoid
M_CR is a proper submonoid of the full transformation monoid T_2

definitions.statement: R and D are algebraically noncommutative on property o iff ∃s∈S_o such that R(D(s))≠D(R(s)).
Given frozen observation Q_o:S_o→Y_o, R and D are observably noncommutative iff ∃s such that Q_o(R(D(s)))≠Q_o(D(R(s))).
s~_Q t iff Q(s)=Q(t). The quotient is transport-stable for generator family M iff s~_Q t implies T(s)~_Q T(t) for every T∈M.
A quotient is prediction-sufficient only if its kernel is a congruence for admitted transport generators and preserves all action-relevant distinctions.
A=D_loc(Q(T_p^o(s)),X,G,E), with Q and D_loc drawn from predeclared mechanism-independent grammar classes.

theorem_targets.statement: Every word over {I,D,R} evaluates to I if it contains no D/R; otherwise it equals the leftmost non-identity generator in composition notation, equivalently the last-applied constant in execution order.
No one-state action represents M_CR faithfully; the two-state action is faithful and minimal.
The path quotient 'contains any D ⇒ failure' is not a congruence once R is admitted.
Algebraic noncommutativity does not imply observable noncommutativity: a non-injective Q may identify R(D(s)) and D(R(s)).
If Q is injective on the orbit Orb_<R,D>(s), algebraic noncommutativity at s implies observable noncommutativity.

For properties o1,o2 the joint transport acts on S_o1×S_o2. A property-independent scalar edge label can be faithful only if the induced edge actions factor through the same scalar partition for both properties.
For every finite mechanism table there exist arbitrary Q and D_loc realizing A=D_loc(Q(state),X,G,E); therefore existence of a factorization alone has zero empirical content.
Any nontrivial bridge claim must be relative to frozen finite grammar classes for Q and D_loc and is unique only up to observationally equivalent relabelings/isomorphisms.

forbidden: injective encoding of whole local state

D_loc.allowed: One shared bounded depth≤2 decision grammar over Q-state plus already-authorized X,G,E coordinates.

restricted_bridge_class.promotion_rule: U0 single bridge survives only if one frozen Q-form and one frozen bounded D_loc grammar classify at least one exact surface-selection family and at least two exact path-transport families with held-out prediction and no mechanism-local exception.

empirical_noncommutativity.strong_witness_requirement: A fresh mechanism must expose source-defined operations L(loss/filter/prune/drop) and R(repair/alias/convert/reconstitute) on materially matched inputs such that L→R and R→L are both executable and differ under a frozen client-observable Q.
empirical_noncommutativity.repair_definition: Explicit reconstruction/promotion/adapter operation that restores a semantic property from information still present before the lossy transform.
empirical_noncommutativity.loss_definition: Transformation that irreversibly removes or quotients information required for later repair.
empirical_noncommutativity.observation_map: Must be frozen before outcome and directly client-observable or test-asserted.

property_indexed_replication.requirement: A second mechanism beyond Flink must show the same physical transformation/boundary acts differently on at least two predeclared properties.
property_indexed_replication.strong_pass: Two properties share the same boundary and source/test packet while requiring distinct transport maps.
property_indexed_replication.support_only: Different classes/routes use different handlers without a shared-boundary comparison.

rivals.claim: One restricted Q,D_loc grammar spans surface-selection and path-transport families.
Surface-selection and path-transport remain distinct but share a stable typed Q-interface.
Repairable/schema transport separates from simple carrier transport enough to require another law family.

law_family_uniqueness.selection_principle: Prefer the coarsest decomposition preserving held-out predictive distinctions under the frozen restricted grammar; never minimize family count by hiding lookup in Q or D_loc.
law_family_uniqueness.uniqueness: Only up to relabeling/isomorphism of latent Q states and equality of induced action partitions/congruences.
law_family_uniqueness.tie_rule: If non-isomorphic restricted decompositions induce identical predictions on all admitted packets, uniqueness remains NOT_AUTHORIZED.
